metadata.title: Synthetic Training Manual: Conflicting Action Rule

page_1.title: Purpose
page_1.raw_text:
Purpose

SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

A CHW records whether synthetic marker X is present.

The marker is the only clinical input in this manual.

blocks.text: SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.
A CHW records whether synthetic marker X is present.
The marker is the only clinical input in this manual.

page_2.title: Conflicting instructions
page_2.raw_text:
Conflicting instructions

If synthetic marker X is present, record SYNTHETIC_HOME and finish the visit.

If synthetic marker X is present, record SYNTHETIC_IMMEDIATE_REFERRAL and finish the visit.

The manual gives no priority, exception, or tie-breaking instruction.

page_3.title: Review expectation
page_3.raw_text:
Review expectation

This contradictory source is a negative fixture.

Do not choose one action by array order or by external knowledge.

Record manual_review_required with conflict_resolution_priority missing.
